_comment: SEAM-TRACKER ROW STORE — declared domains (roadmap A3, spec SPEC-row-store.md §3).
Bridge hosts; Foundry specs. Every domain below ENUMERATES THE BOUNDED SIDE per
§P4 (the floor rule): an unrecognised value must FAIL LOUDLY, never bucket silently.
The generator refuses the index on any value not listed here.
AXIS STATES ARE COPIED FROM NOWHERE — they are the INVENTORY-SCHEMA §4 vocabulary,
transcribed once here so the validator has a machine-readable form. If §4 changes,
this file is wrong and the generator's --check-schema flag says so.

id.why: 8 lowercase hex, 's' prefix, randomly minted. No counter: a counter needs an allocator and an allocator needs a lane to remember it (spec §2). Collisions surface as a filename clash in git.

doorway.why: spec §3. Bounded: these four exhaust the reachability question.

destination.why: axis A of the ownership map (OWNERSHIP-WORKSHEET 'Axis A — WHERE DOES IT GO').

axes._why: INVENTORY-SCHEMA §4, the five axes. A row carries per-axis state, never one bare 'state' field — one field cannot answer five questions (the A5 ruling's own argument).

required_if._why: spec §3: negative-control is mandatory at intake for PATCH rows — 'assumed-necessary does not ship'.

never_stored.provenance: parsed live from the TU's own KIT-LINEAGE header via kit_laws.lineage(); a copied value is a second roster that drifts (the fifth-roster failure). A row file carrying a literal provenance value is REFUSED.

citation_rule.why: spec §3: on a live tree 'I read X' and 'it is Y' are both true — the WwPilot 0->2 lesson, where an untracked file's prior state was unrecoverable and only a verbatim quote survived.
